newsitem.title: USA: Comdisco cleared to lease to government.
newsitem.headline: Comdisco cleared to lease to government.

text.p: Comdisco Inc said Monday it has been given clearance by the federal government to lease computer and other high-tech equipment to government agencies.
In the past, Comdisco was allowed to lease goods to agencies only under an agreement in which the agencies would eventually buy the goods, the company said.
The change stemmed from an amendment to the company's General Services Administration schedule that allows Comdisco to expand leasing services to all federal government agencies.

Comdisco leases equipment such as PCs and workstations, mainframes, midrange and distributed systems, and telecommunications, networking, and point-of-sale equipment. The company has had a GSA schedule for leasing since 1989, it said.
